run_download_dtc_objects: run the CLI to download Digital Twin Catalog objects from a CDN file to a local output folder
run_download_specific_objects: run the CLI with specific object names to download only selected DTC objects
run_download_with_file_keys: run the CLI with file keys like 3d-asset_glb or metadata to download specific file types
run_download_with_prefixes: run the CLI with file key prefixes like previews_ to download only preview data
run_download_specific_releases: run the CLI with release names to download only selected DTC releases
